# Healthcare Performance Indicators

This folder contains supplementary national quality metrics used in the Danish Acute Surgery Database to evaluate the speed of acute surgical interventions. The indicators track the proportion of patients operated on within six hours of hospital arrival, stratified by the severity of their condition. Both metrics highlight severe systemic shortfalls in acute surgical capacity and triage across Denmark, with national compliance rates falling drastically short of the established 90% quality standard.

## Pages

- [[indikator-5x|Indikator 5x]] — Measures the proportion of patients with life-threatening conditions (perforation, ischemia, or bleeding) operated on within six hours, revealing a national compliance rate of only 21.2% against a 90% standard.
- [[indikator-5y|Indikator 5y]] — Tracks the speed of acute surgery for patients without life-threatening conditions, showing a national compliance rate of just 14.7% and universal failure to meet the quality target.
